What Is Stem Cell Therapy for Hair Loss?

Your Body Already Has What It Takes to Regrow Hair

Stem cell therapy taps into your own regenerative power to kickstart hair growth in thinning or weak areas of the scalp.
Stem cell therapy is a revolutionary treatment that uses the regenerative power of stem cells to promote hair growth.

Stem cells, unique cells in the body capable of transforming into different types of cells, play a crucial role in repairing and regenerating damaged tissues.

When applied to hair follicles, these cells can stimulate hair regrowth by promoting the production of new, healthy hair follicles.

The process involves extracting stem cells from your body, typically from areas such as bone marrow or fat tissue, and injecting them into the scalp.

These stem cells work to repair damaged hair follicles, reverse the miniaturization process (shrinking of hair follicles), and encourage the growth of new hair.

How Does the Treatment Work?

No Surgery. No Downtime. Just Pure Regrowth.

The process is simple, safe, and done in under 90 minutes.
✅ Step 1: Consultation & Scalp Analysis
We examine your scalp, hair density, and thinning patterns to ensure stem cell therapy is the right choice for you and create a customized plan.
✅ Step 2: Stem Cell Extraction
Stem cells are extracted from areas rich in them, such as your bone marrow or fat tissue. This is done using a minimally invasive procedure to ensure patient comfort.
✅ Step 3: Extraction of Regenerative Cells
The collected sample is processed in a specialized centrifuge system to isolate growth factor-rich stem cells that are responsible for healing and tissue regeneration. This part takes around 30–45 minutes.
✅ Step 4: Scalp Injection
The prepared stem cell solution is then carefully injected into the thinning or weak areas of your scalp. The goal is to stimulate dormant hair follicles and promote natural regrowth.
✅ Step 5: Recovery & Follow-Up
There’s no downtime—you can resume your normal activities the same day. We’ll guide you through aftercare and schedule follow-up sessions spaced 3–4 weeks apart for optimal results.
You may start seeing visible changes in 8–12 weeks, with full results in a few months.
